hypotheses.text: Homologous Kelch13 propeller-domain mutations confer artemisinin resistance in P. knowlesi via the same reduced ring-stage susceptibility mechanism documented in P. falciparum.

claims.text: Kelch13 propeller-domain mutations reduce artemisinin susceptibility in Plasmodium species.

references.raw: Ariey F, et al. A molecular marker of artemisinin-resistant Plasmodium falciparum malaria. Nature 2014.

hypotheses.text: Ring-stage drug tolerance is modulated by plasma membrane lipid composition, independent of Kelch13 mutation status.

claims.text: Lipid remodelling in the ring stage affects membrane permeability to artemisinin derivatives.

hypotheses.text: Reticulocyte-restricted invasion in P. knowlesi shapes recrudescence dynamics under drug pressure, independent of intrinsic resistance mutations.

claims.text: P. knowlesi preferentially invades reticulocytes, a niche with distinct drug exposure kinetics.
